Several DBAASP rows record subject_name as 'Escherichia coli ESBL ' without isolate number; concentration patterns map to Table 3 E. coli N°44 and are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
Primary Table 3 includes E. coli clinical isolate N°40 values that are preserved in activity evidence; linked database snapshots do not provide separate N°40 rows for all peptides.
SEM and ONPG evidence support E. coli membrane/cell-envelope damage and permeabilization for 35409-1, but no exact molecular pore model is asserted.
